provenance.normalization: lowercase; strip one trailing "'s"; strip punctuation; collapse whitespace; strip one trailing plural "s"
provenance.freeze_protocol: The dataset eval/data/prediction_eval_set.jsonl is frozen at its first commit. After the first live run, items may never be edited, added, or removed in response to results. One headline live run per condition (full and context-ablated). Any future change to the set requires a new versioned filename and both old and new results files must be kept.
